title: Cultural Disposition
description: Cultural, religious, and regulatory constraints on how an asset or property may be disposed of. Covers sacred status, disposal restrictions, export controls, and whether the item can be bequeathed

sacredStatus.description: Whether this item has religious or spiritual significance that restricts disposal
sacredStatus.$comment: secular: no religious significance. consecrated: blessed or sanctified by a religious authority (e.g. Buddhist statue consecrated by a monk). ritually_significant: not formally consecrated but holds ritual importance (e.g. Hindu puja items, family altar). inalienable_endowment: permanently dedicated to charitable or religious purposes — cannot be sold or bequeathed (e.g. Islamic waqf property).

culturalSignificance.description: The cultural weight of this item — determines who should be consulted about its disposition
culturalSignificance.$comment: personal: significant to the owner only. family_heirloom: passed down through generations — family should be consulted. community: significant to a community or clan (e.g. ancestral jade, clan property). national_heritage: classified as national heritage — government restrictions likely apply.

bequeathable.description: Whether this item can be willed to another person. False for waqf endowments, some ancestral property, and inalienable cultural artefacts

disposalRestrictions.description: Specific restrictions on how this item may be disposed of, with the authority that imposes each restriction

authority.description: Name of the authority imposing this restriction

exportRestrictions.description: Legal restrictions on exporting this item from its current jurisdiction

restrictionType.$comment: cultural_property: classified cultural property requiring export licence. national_treasure: designated national treasure — export likely prohibited. antiquity: items over a threshold age requiring approval (e.g. China: 100 years). protected_species: items made from protected materials (ivory, certain woods). controlled_goods: items subject to general export controls.

authority.description: The government body or agency that controls export

licenceRequired.description: Whether a licence or permit is required for export
